source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As the [first battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) begins, roll D6s by [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size) to make your Fate dice: 3 in Incursion, 6 in Strike Force or 9 in Onslaught. Set them aside as your Fate dice pool.

Whenever you use a Stratagem from the list below, if your pool has a Fate die showing that Stratagem's value, you can discard a die showing it to make that use cost 1CP less. The values are:

- 1: [Presentiment of Dread](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.presentiment-of-dread)
- 2: [Forewarned](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.forewarned)
- 3: [Unshrouded Truth](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.unshrouded-truth)
- 4: [Fate Inescapable](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.fate-inescapable)
- 5: [Isha’s Fury](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.ishas-fury)
- 6: [Psychic Shield](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.psychic-shield)
